human_owner.summary: Approved in advance by the owner through auto mode; the Claude reviewer decides.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Psoas major appears as a 0.2 synergist because the table lists it under lumbar_spine/flexion. This comes from the tracer's weighting. With feet flat and no hip flexion action in the definition, no authoring choice would change it, so it is a tracer limitation.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: None required. Treat this tracer limitation the same way in every review.

non_blocking_findings.finding: open_chain is a defensible label because the feet are not loaded against a fixed support. The feet are in contact with the floor, so some reviewers might prefer closed_chain. This label does not change the traced muscles.
non_blocking_findings.suggested_correction: Keep open_chain, or note that the feet-on-floor contact is incidental.

model_reviewer.summary: The frozen definition matches the source instructions and both frames: a bilateral, bodyweight supine crunch with knees bent, feet flat and arms held overhead in line with the head. lumbar_spine/flexion as the primary action correctly gives rectus abdominis as primary and the obliques as synergists. shoulder_position_hold is a reasonable way to credit the arms held overhead against gravity as the torso curls up. It yields only low-coefficient shoulder stabilizers, with the clavicular deltoid highest at 0.35, and no grip or arm-joint muscles are wrongly engaged. The tracer profile has no materially wrong muscle pattern.
